branchingCuttoon.page.title: I-cuttoon enamagatsha
branchingCuttoon.page.intro: Ithuluzi lokuhlola lokwakha i-cuttoon indaba yayo egatshayo uma abafundi bekhetha ukukhetha, nokuyibuka kuqala.
branchingCuttoon.page.limitsNote: Akukho ukugcinwa kuseva, izibalo zabafundi noma ukukhokhelana okwamanje. Indaba yakho igcinwa kuphela kulesi siphequluli, ngakho yikhiphe njenge-JSON bese ugcina ikhophi.
branchingCuttoon.page.replaceConfirm: Faka esikhundleni sohlaka lwamanje (izigcawu ezingu-{count})? Okuqukethwe kwamanje kuzolahleka. Khipha njenge-JSON kuqala uma ufuna ukukubuyisa kamuva.
branchingCuttoon.page.appliedSample: Kulayishwe indaba yesampula. Ifundeka ngaphandle kwamaphutha futhi ifaka isexwayiso esisodwa sokubuyela emuva.
branchingCuttoon.page.appliedImport: Kungeniswe ifayela elinezigcawu ezingu-{count}. Hlola imiphumela yokubuyekeza.
branchingCuttoon.editor.heading: Yakha indaba
branchingCuttoon.editor.intro: Yakha izigcawu njengohlu bese wengeza ukusikwa nokukhetha esigcawini ngasinye. Khetha into emiphumeleni yokubuyekeza ukuze uye endaweni okufanele ilungiswe.
branchingCuttoon.editor.emptyBody: Dala isigcawu sokuvula, noma layisha isampula ukuze ubone ukuthi yakhiwe kanjani.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockNodeLimit: Ungenza izigcawu ezifika ku-{max}. Susa isigcawu ongasidingi bese uzama futhi.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockChoiceLimit: Isigcawu ngasinye singaba nokukhetha okufika ku-{max}.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockCutLimit: Isigcawu ngasinye singaba nokusikwa okufika ku-{max}.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockNotFound: Into ezohlelwa ayitholakalanga. Khetha isigcawu ohlwini futhi.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockStartProtec: Isigcawu sokuvula asikwazi ukususwa noma ukushintshwa uhlobo. Beka esinye isigcawu njengesigcawu sokuvula kuqala.
branchingCuttoon.editor.blockIdExhausted: Isihlonzi esisha asikwazanga ukudalwa. Nciphisa izigcawu noma ukusikwa bese uzama futhi.
branchingCuttoon.nodes.heading: Izigcawu ({count}/{max})
branchingCuttoon.node.heading: Hlela isigcawu: {title}
branchingCuttoon.node.startCannotDelete: Isigcawu sokuvula asikwazi ukususwa. Beka esinye isigcawu njengesigcawu sokuvula ukuze ususe lesi.
branchingCuttoon.node.deleteConfirm: Susa lesi sigcawu? Ukukhetha okungu-{count} okuholela lapha nakho kuyasuswa.
branchingCuttoon.cuts.heading: Ukusikwa ({count}/{max})
branchingCuttoon.cuts.hint: Abafundi bafunda ukusikwa kusuka phezulu kuya phansi. Okwamanje ukusikwa kungamakhadi ombhalo; ukuxhumanisa izithombe kuwumgomo wesikhathi esizayo.
branchingCuttoon.cuts.empty: Akukho ukusikwa okwamanje. Engeza ukusikwa ukuze ugcwalise isigcawu.
branchingCuttoon.cuts.captionMissing: Lokhu kusikwa akukho etafuleni lokusikwa ({value}). Kususe bese wengeza okusha.
branchingCuttoon.choices.heading: Ukukhetha ({count}/{max})
branchingCuttoon.choices.hint: Abafundi bacindezela lokhu ekupheleni kwesigcawu. Amagama kufanele ahluke, futhi ukukhetha ngakunye kudinga isigcawu okuyiwa kuso.
branchingCuttoon.choices.endingHint: Izigcawu zesiphetho azinakho ukukhetha. Ukukhetha okusele kufihliwe kubafundi, ngakho kususe.
branchingCuttoon.issues.heading: Imiphumela yokubuyekeza
branchingCuttoon.issues.allClear: Akukho okufanele kulungiswe. Hlola indaba Ekubukeni Kuqala.
branchingCuttoon.issues.summaryWarningsO: Azikho amaphutha, futhi izexwayiso ezingu-{warnings} okufanele zihlolwe. Ungayibuka kuqala indaba.
branchingCuttoon.issues.summaryErrors: Amaphutha angu-{errors} okufanele alungiswe nezexwayiso ezingu-{warnings} okufanele zihlolwe. Awukwazi ukubuka kuqala kuze kulungiswe amaphutha.
branchingCuttoon.issues.startMissing: Asikho isigcawu sokuvula. Beka isigcawu esisodwa njengesigcawu sokuvula.
branchingCuttoon.issues.startDangling: Isigcawu esibekwe njengesigcawu sokuvula asitholakalanga ({value}). Khetha isigcawu sokuvula futhi.
branchingCuttoon.issues.startKindMismatc: {title}: Lesi sigcawu sibekwe njengesigcawu sokuvula kodwa uhlobo lwaso akulona Ukuqala. Sibeke futhi njengesigcawu sokuvula kusuka ohlwini lwezigcawu.

branchingCuttoon.issues.deadEnd: {title}: Lokhu kungukuphela okuyimpumputhe. Akusona isiphetho kodwa akunakho ukukhetha abafundi abangakucindezela. Engeza ukukhetha noma ukwenze isiphetho.

branchingCuttoon.issues.endingHasChoices: {title}: Ukukhetha okungu-{count} esigcawini sesiphetho kufihliwe kubafundi. Kususe noma shintsha uhlobo lwesigcawu.
branchingCuttoon.issues.nodeTitleEmpty: Isigcawu asinaso isihloko. Izihloko zivela ohlwini nasezimemezelweni, ngakho faka esisodwa.

branchingCuttoon.transfer.heading: Khipha futhi ngenisa
branchingCuttoon.transfer.intro: Izindaba zihamba njengamafayela e-JSON. Akukho okuthunyelwa kuseva; ukufunda nokubhala kuhlala kule divayisi.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.exportHint: Kuguqula uhlaka lwamanje lube yi-JSON njengoba lunjalo. Ungakhipha ngisho noma amaphutha esekhona.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.exportedFile: Kukhishwe ifayela. Gcina ifayela elilandiwe endaweni ephephile.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.exportedCopy: Kukopishwe i-JSON. Yinamathisele enothini noma efayeleni ukuze uyigcine.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.exportFileFail: Ifayela alikwazanga ukukhishwa. Cindezela inkinobho ethi Kopisha i-JSON bese uzigcinela wena.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.exportCopyFail: Ukukopisha akusebenzanga. Cindezela inkinobho ethi Khipha njengefayela le-JSON ukuze uthole ifayela.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.importHint: Vula ifayela le-JSON elikhishwe kulesi sikrini. Uma isimo sivumelekile, lithatha indawo yohlaka lwamanje.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.readFailed: Ifayela alikwazanga ukufundwa. Zama futhi noma khetha elinye ifayela.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.importFailed: Ukungenisa akusebenzanga. Hlola isimo sefayela bese uzama futhi.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseEmpty: Akunalutho. Namathisela umbhalo we-JSON noma khetha ifayela.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseTooLarge: Ifayela likhulu kakhulu. Amafayela afika ku-{max} MiB kuphela afundwa. Hlola ukuthi ifayela elikhishiwe yini.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseNotJson: Ayiyona i-JSON evumelekile. Hlola ukuthi ifayela elikhishiwe yini.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseNotObject: Inani le-JSON elingaphandle kakhulu aliyona into. Hlola ukuthi ifayela elikhishiwe yini.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseWrongForm: Leli akulona ifayela le-cuttoon enamagatsha. Hlola ukuthi likhishwe kulesi sikrini yini.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseUnsupport: Le nombolo yenguqulo ayisekelwa. Hlola ukuthi ikhishwe kulesi sikrini yini.
branchingCuttoon.transfer.parseUnknownKi: Uhlobo lwesigcawu ku-{path} alwaziwa. Kufanele kube ukuqala, isigcawu noma isiphetho.
branchingCuttoon.storage.draftUnreadable: Uhlaka olugcinwe alukwazanga ukufundwa, ngakho kuqalwe uhlaka olusha. Uhlaka oludala luthathwa indawo uma usushintsha okuthile. Uma ukhiphe ifayela le-JSON, lilayishe ngenkinobho yokungenisa.
branchingCuttoon.storage.saveFailed: Uhlaka alukwazanga ukugcinwa kulesi siphequluli. Lokho okubona lapha akushintshile. Cindezela inkinobho ethi Khipha njengefayela le-JSON ukuze ugcine ikhophi.
branchingCuttoon.player.heading: Buka kuqala
branchingCuttoon.player.intro: Yifunde ngendlela abafundi abazoyifunda ngayo. Indawo yakho igcinwa kuphela kulesi siphequluli.
branchingCuttoon.player.emptyBody: Engeza izigcawu ku-Yakha, noma layisha isampula.
branchingCuttoon.player.blockedBody: Indaba enamaphutha asele angu-{count} ayikwazi ukubukwa kuqala. Hlola imiphumela yokubuyekeza ku-Yakha.
branchingCuttoon.player.cutMissing: Umbhalo walokhu kusikwa awukwazanga ukufundwa. Hlola uhlu lokusikwa ku-Yakha.
branchingCuttoon.player.endingHint: Qala phansi, noma buyela emuva bese uzama ukukhetha okuhlukile.
branchingCuttoon.player.resetByChange: Izindlela zendaba zishintshile, ngakho uqala phansi.
branchingCuttoon.player.saveFailed: Indawo yakho ayikwazanga ukugcinwa kulesi siphequluli. Ungaqhubeka ufunde, futhi ukugcina kuzanywa futhi ekukhetheni okulandelayo.
branchingCuttoon.player.renderFailed: Ukubuka kuqala akukwazanga ukudwetshwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut2: Umlingiswa oyinhloko ufinyelela esikhwameni efuna isambulela bese uyama.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut3: Ekupheleni komhubhe ingane engaziwa ima emvuleni.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut4: Ingane ingena ngaphansi kwesambulela, ibukeka yethukile.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut5: Ingane ibonisa ngokucophelela ukhiye omncane ewuphethe ngesandla esisodwa.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut6: Izinyathelo ezimbalwa phambili, izinyathelo ezingafani nemvula zilandelela ngemuva.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut7: Uma ubheka emuva, ingane ayisekho futhi isibani somgwaqo kuphela ekupheleni komhubhe siyacwayiza.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut9: Bobabili bahamba ngokuthula, babelana ngesambulela esisodwa.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut10: Incwadi eyabhalwa kudala ingaphakathi kwelokha. Inagama lomlingiswa oyinhloko.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut11: Emnyango ingane iqhawula ngesandla imamatheka. Amahlombe amanzi, kodwa inhliziyo ifudumele.
branchingCuttoon.sample.cut12: Ekhaya, izicathulo ezimanzi ziyakhunyulwa. Ngaphandle kwefasitela imvula iyaqhubeka ina.
